effect_description_eng:
[On Play] You may place 1 [SkullKnightmon] and 1 [DeadlyAxemon] from your hand and/or trash in this Digimon's digivolution cards in any order.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted, you may play 1 [SkullKnightmon] and 1 [DeadlyAxemon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards suspended without paying their memory costs.
